# Compass

> > Compass is a luxury real estate marketplace connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with top agents, exclusive listings, and premium services across major U.S. markets.

Compass operates a comprehensive real estate platform featuring property search, agent networks, neighborhood guides, and premium services like concierge support. The platform spans major markets including San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and other key metropolitan areas with a focus on luxury residential real estate.

- [Compass Homepage](https://www.compass.com): Compass homepage: buy, sell, rent with local agents and exclusive services

- [Homes for Sale - Brooklyn](https://www.compass.com/homes-for-sale/brooklyn-ny): Brooklyn homes for sale with 3,911+ listings in neighborhoods
- [Apartments & Homes for Rent](https://www.compass.com/for-rent): San Jose rental apartments and homes search with viewings
